Collegium Musicum Iuvenale Ochsenfurt

Group Excursion to Nuremberg

June 28, 2025 · Nuremberg

The CMI group spent a varied day in Nuremberg. The adults delved into art history during a guided tour with Prof. Dr. Teresa Bischoff at the Germanisches Nationalmuseum, while the children explored the interactive stations with a "museum kit" in a playful way. After a group photo in front of the museum, we walked to the "Field of Experiences for the Senses." The sound tent was especially exciting, where the children, in particular, tried out and discovered different types of sounds with great curiosity. For refreshments, we went to the nearby beer garden, where we enjoyed lunch or a coffee break together. It was a wonderful day full of discoveries, fun, and community!
